up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) for all molecules that have a chemical structure defined and have a non-null preferred name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.pref_name IS NOT NULL
